title: Absolute's Protector
summary: Wearers with the Absolute’s Brand take 1 less damage from spells. Cast Fire Shield: Chill as an Action once per Long Rest for Fire resistance and 2d8 Cold retaliation against melee attackers. Shield Bash. When hit by a melee attack, use a Reaction to attempt to knock the attacker Prone. A Dexterity save resists.

fields.Effect: Wearers with the Absolute’s Brand take 1 less damage from spells. Shield Bash is a Reaction when hit by a melee attack; the attacker can resist falling Prone with a Dexterity save.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Fire Shield: Chill: Action once per Long Rest. For 10 turns, gain Fire resistance, emit light in a 10 ft radius, and deal 2d8 Cold to creatures that hit you in melee.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
